routine_trigger_bindings.definition: CREATE TRIGGER users_create_wallet AFTER INSERT ON users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION create_user_wallet()

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (comment_id) REFERENCES comments(comment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (review_id) REFERENCES reviews(review_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['success'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying, 'refunded'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying]::text[]))

CHECK (type::text = ANY (ARRAY['top_up'::character varying, 'purchase'::character varying, 'refund'::character varying, 'cancel'::character varying, 'admin_credit'::character varying, 'admin_debit'::character varying, 'creator_earning'::character varying, 'platform_fee'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying]::text[]))
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX comment_reactions_pkey ON public.comment_reactions USING btree (user_id, comment_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_comment_reactions_count ON public.comment_reactions USING btree (comment_id, reaction_type)
CREATE INDEX idx_review_reactions_count ON public.review_reactions USING btree (review_id, reaction_type)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX review_reactions_pkey ON public.review_reactions USING btree (user_id, review_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wallet_transactions_one_reversal ON public.wallet_transactions USING btree (reversal_of_transaction_id) WHERE (reversal_of_transaction_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wallet_transactions_pkey ON public.wallet_transactions USING btree (transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX wallet_transactions_reference ON public.wallet_transactions USING btree (reference_key) WHERE (reference_key IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX wallet_transactions_user_created ON public.wallet_transactions USING btree (user_id, created_at DESC, transaction_id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wallet_transactions_user_idempotency ON public.wallet_transactions USING btree (user_id, idempotency_key) WHERE ((idempotency_key IS NOT NULL) AND (user_id IS NOT NULL))
